key_findings: Convention choice dominates measured edge: 3 consecutive experiments (E019/E020, E023, E035) showed overnight vs c2c divergence. Policy v1.2.3 sets primary = c2c.

Roll artifacts in yfinance continuous futures: median seam gaps 0.3-2.5%; CL 2020 wedge -306%/-127% overnight. De-seaming improves TSM OOS Sharpe by 21% (E016) to 3x (E017) and flips bear Sharpe from -1.06 to +0.15.

yfinance quarterly fundamentals are DATA-INFEASIBLE for 2014-2026 walk-forward: only ~6 trailing quarters available (earliest 2025-01-31) vs ~50 required. Confirmed by ground-truth probe across 132 tickers.
All stat-arb variants fail on 2014-2026 large_liquid: E021 distance (0.315, z=0.77) and E025 cointegration (-0.573, z=-0.86) - honest negatives.
Macro momentum (E022) shows genuine crisis alpha (bear +0.792, COVID +2.01, 2022 +1.87) but fails promotion bar on US-only implementation.
The only surviving market-neutral strategy is DN low-beta (E012/E013); all others carry equity beta or fail gates.
No promoted strategy survives v1.2.3 convention-aligned gates as a market-neutral total portfolio.
